axes_note: start_time is seconds-of-local-day [0..86400); duration is seconds (clipped upstream at 7 days = 604800); energy is kWh. ev-flow's plug_in_model converts start_time to hours-LT (divide by 3600) at consumption time and currently ignores the duration/energy marginals (v3.1 scope).

source.citation: Powell, S.; Cezar, G.V.; Rajagopal, R. (2022) Scalable Probabilistic Estimates of Electric Vehicle Charging Given Observed Driver Behavior. Applied Energy 309, doi:10.1016/j.apenergy.2021.118382
